data.notes: Search budget (20) used. Honda sold in Germany 2005-2026 for these nameplates: Accord VII (2003-2008) and VIII (2008-2015) as Limousine and Tourer, Insight II (2009-2013), CR-Z (2010-2016), Legend IV (2006-2010). Insight I and Legend III ended before 2005 / not officially sold in Germany; later Insight/Legend/Accord generations were not sold in Germany. Most values from ADAC catalogue and databases since Honda EU press data was rarely reachable.

corrections.evidence: Wikipedia lists wheelbase 2,670 mm (105.1 in) for the 7th-gen JDM/Euro Accord sedan (4665 x 1760 x 1445). Consistent with Honda launch info that the Tourer (2720 mm) has a 50 mm longer wheelbase than the saloon (fleetnews 17 Oct 2002); autozine.nl also gives 267 cm.

Honda launch release: 'class leading load volume with all seats in place of 576 litres (VDA), rising to 921 litres with the one-motion rear seats folded' (also autozine.nl 10 Oct 2002 and Auto Bild 'Neuer Honda Accord': 576 l). Manufacturer figure preferred over ADAC catalogue 518 l. Note the manufacturer's 921 l folded is to window line; roof-high 1657 l (ADAC) kept.
Honda launch figure 576 l VDA seats up (same body for all engines).
Honda launch figure 576 l VDA seats up (same body for all engines).
Auto Bild: Accord Tourer 576 Liter Fassungsvermögen, 921 l bis Fensterlinie bei umgelegter Rückbank (Honda figure, same body for all engines).

ADAC catalogue lists 225 l normal for CR-Z 1.5 Hybrid S and Sport (06/10-12/12); only the GT trim is listed with 215 l (likely subwoofer). Top Gear spec (1.5 IMA S) also 225 l seats up; AutoScout24 225 l. 225 l is the base/most common figure; GT = 215 l.
ADAC for S/Sport: 401 l window-high, 595 l roof-high folded (GT: 389/583). Encycarpedia/mobile.de also 225-595 l. Pairs with trunkL 225.

ADAC facelift entry 'Honda CR-Z 1.5 Hybrid GT (01/13 - 12/13)', 137 PS. German sources (mobile.de/AutoScout24 model pages) state sales in Germany were discontinued at end of 2013 due to weak sales; 2016 is only the global production end.
ADAC: facelift 137 PS built/offered 01/13 - 12/13 in Germany; German sales ended end of 2013.
cars-data.com gives 4,985 mm length, 1,845 mm width, 1,450 mm height for the 2008-2010 Legend (facelift); cararac also 1450. Not a manufacturer source (one sheet lists 1455).

verification.notes: 15 WebSearch calls used. Confirmed: Accord VII sedan 4665/1760/1445, 459 l, 2003-2008; Accord VIII sedan 4725/1840/1440/2705 and 467 l VDA (Honda launch material; 459 l belongs to gen VII); Accord VII Tourer length 4750, wheelbase 2720; Accord VIII Tourer 4750/1840/2705 (height 1470 per cars-data, L'argus says 1.44 m - not changed); Insight II 1695/1425, 408 l (length 4390-4395 and wheelbase 2545-2550 vary by source, left as is; 1017 l folded not re-found); CR-Z 4080/1740/1395/2425 (ADAC; some sources 2435 wb / 4075 length); Legend IV 4957/1845/1450/2800/452 l; Legend facelift German launch spring 2009 (automobile.at), width/wheelbase/452 l. Legend facelift length conflict unresolved (4957 per cararac/auto-data vs 4985 per cars-data/fastcarcheck) - not changed. No missing generations found; Honda sold no PHEV/4x4 variants of these besides Legend SH-AWD. Accord VII Tourer roof-high folded 1657 l (ADAC) not contradicted by a manufacturer figure (Honest John quotes 626-1707 l, unclear method).
